title: Choose one storage backend while preserving Kanbus behavior
description:
As a Kanbus operator, I want to select filesystem/EFS or cloud storage so deployment choice does not change issue behavior.

Feature: Interchangeable Kanbus persistence
  Scenario Outline: Persist through the selected backend
    Given a project explicitly configured for <backend>
    When an authorized user creates, updates and reloads a typed issue
    Then its full identity, raw fields and configured workflow are preserved
    And only the selected backend is authoritative
    Examples:
      | backend |
      | local filesystem |
      | EFS filesystem |
      | S3 canonical content with DynamoDB catalog |
  Scenario: Keep Git a supported choice
    Given a filesystem project managed with Git
    When an operator commits and reviews its issue changes
    Then its existing local issue-file workflow remains available
    And no implicit cloud dual-write occurs
